description: .NET SDK for AliExpress Open Platform affiliate APIs, including affiliate link generation, product discovery, promotions, categories, product details, order lookups, and an affiliate reporting client (conversions, sales summary).
releaseNotes: 1.3.2 fixes URL normalization in GenerateAffiliateLinkAsync/GenerateAffiliateLinksAsync: query strings were being silently dropped from any AliExpress URL containing ".html" outside the canonical /item/{ID}.html product page (e.g. campaign/landing pages with a meaningful query string after their own .html segment). The tracking-cruft trim (designed for /item/{ID}.html?spm=...) now only applies to that specific path shape; every other AliExpress .html URL keeps its query string as-is. 1.3.1 makes NoRecord a strict API verdict instead of an inference: DetailOutcome.NoRecord is now returned ONLY when the productdetail.get response explicitly states current_record_count 0 (the real shape returned for non-affiliable products — validated against AliExpress link builder). Anomalous HTTP 200 responses that previously slipped into NoRecord — a record present but with no title/image fields, an empty products object accepted as a product, or an unrecognized response shape without current_record_count or products — now throw AliExpressAffiliateApiException and surface as DetailOutcome.ApiError (transient, retryable) so callers that treat NoRecord as permanent (e.g. dropping non-affiliable products for good) never drop on a malformed response. Behavior note for direct callers: GetProductDetailsAsync and AliExpressOpenPlatformDiagnostics.ExtractProductDetails now THROW AliExpressAffiliateApiException for those anomalous 200 responses where they previously returned null or an empty details object — wrap direct calls in a try/catch if you relied on the silent null. 1.3.0 classifies WHY product details are missing in GenerateDualLinkWithDetailsAsync via the new AliExpressDetailOutcome enum on AliExpressDualLinkWithDetails.DetailOutcome. Previously any failure of the productdetail.get call collapsed to Details=null and callers could not tell a PERMANENT gap (product has no record in the affiliate catalog — e.g. app-only/coin deals, HTTP 200 with current_record_count 0 → NoRecord) from TRANSIENT failures (RateLimited after ApiCallLimit retries, Timeout on the SDK's internal deadline, TransportError on network faults, ApiError on other error_response/resp_code). This lets callers retry transients but stop retrying permanent gaps. Also threads an optional ILogger into AliExpressAffiliateClient/service so these outcomes are no longer silent (the affiliate core previously had no logging). Fully backward compatible: DetailOutcome defaults to Ok and the logger defaults to NullLogger. 1.2.4 adds GenerateDualLinkAsync (links-only): from a single productId/URL it returns just the TWO affiliate links (site + app) in a SINGLE batched link.generate call, skipping productdetail.get entirely. This is the preferred path when the caller already has product data (title/price/image) from another source such as a cross-tenant cache — only the per-tenant links are missing, and the productdetail call (the one that most often hits ApiCallLimit, dropping the photo) is avoided. 1.2.4 also spaces the two calls in GenerateDualLinkWithDetailsAsync: a configurable pause (AliExpressAffiliateOptions.DelayBetweenLinkAndDetailMilliseconds, default 1000ms; 0 disables) is inserted between link.generate and productdetail.get, giving the ~1 req/s app quota room to recover BEFORE the rate-limited call instead of only retrying after it fails. 1.2.3 adds GenerateDualLinkWithDetailsAsync: from a single productId/URL it returns BOTH affiliate links (site + app) of the same product plus product details (title/price/image) using only 2 AliExpress calls — one batched link.generate (source_values=site,app) and one productdetail.get with built-in backoff retry on ApiCallLimit. This replaces the previous dual-link flow that made ~4 calls (link.generate + productdetail per variant) and silently dropped the rate-limited productdetail, publishing offers without a photo. 1.2.2 makes product-detail enrichment best-effort during affiliate link generation: when GenerateAffiliateLinkAsync(IncludeProductDetails=true) succeeds on the link.generate call but the follow-up productdetail.get call fails (e.g. ApiCallLimit rate limiting, internal timeout, or non-catalog product), the already-generated affiliate link is now returned WITHOUT product details instead of throwing and discarding the link. Caller cancellation still propagates. 1.2.1 was a maintenance release (CI workflow + package metadata, no API changes). 1.2.0 adds AliExpressAffiliateCredentialException and AliExpressAffiliateCredentialFailureKind so callers can distinguish rejected AliExpress Open Platform credentials from transient HTTP failures and non-affiliable products. HTTP 401/403 and Open Platform signature/app key/session/permission errors now surface as non-retryable credential failures.
title: AliExpress Affiliate SDK for .NET
